exposure: human umbilical cord-derived mesenchymal stem cells (hUC-MSCs) injections
outcome: Motor function (Gross Motor Function Measure, 6-Minute Walk Test, Timed Up and Go test, Lovett's test)
cohort: The study included 152 children diagnosed with cerebral palsy.
finding: The application of hUC-MSCs generally enhanced functional performance in children with cerebral palsy, improving motor function and mental abilities, though individual responses varied and younger patients responded better.
